scope: California 2025-2026 session: four workplace laws only
review_method: Agent read the selected 09/30/26 Chaptered version in the browser on California Legislative Information. Legal applicability requires counsel review; this is not human legal sign-off.

effective_date_basis.reasoning: All four are regular-session statutes enacted on 2026-09-30. None has an urgency clause. January 1 following the 90-day period is 2027-01-01. AB 1883, AB 1331, and SB 951 contain no later operative-date provision. SB 947 expressly delays operation of its new Labor Code part.

anchors: Section 1561: bathroom monitoring and possession exceptions
claims.summary: Limits workplace bathroom surveillance and allows leaving surveillance tools behind, subject to exceptions. Covers non-AI tools too.

anchors: Section 1581: emotion inference, neural data, and safety language
claims.summary: Restricts AI surveillance of employee emotions and neural data. September 3 was the enrolled-version date, not the signing date.

claims.operative_date_quote: This part shall become operative on July 1, 2027.
claims.summary: Bars sole ADS reliance for discipline or termination. Primary reliance requires human corroboration and post-use notice. The new Labor Code part has an express later operative date.
Adds technology-displacement details to otherwise required Cal/WARN notices. Retains 60-day notice. Hiring-cessation notices are a topic for an EDD study, not a new employer notice duty in this text.
